snippet.title: Pidgeon Pocket | Superpowers Update | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Every pigeon gets a superpower.
Pidgeon Pocket (yes, with a d; many people search it as Pigeon Pocket) is a cute pixel incremental heist game about pigeons who pickpocket a park full of clueless picnickers. Click someone in the crowd and a pigeon dives for their pocket. Spend the loot on a 34-upgrade tree, hatch an egg every level and grow a flock of five.
https://lianes8studio.com/pidgeon

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4852570/
Play the free demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4872340/
Free demo on itch.io: https://lianes8.itch.io/pidgeon-pocket-demo
On Android (Google Play): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.jlianes.pidgeonpocket

Early Access starts November 9, 2026.

What's in the Superpowers Update:
- 20 superpowers, one per pigeon, 5 levels each
- An egg every level with three choices, and every fifth egg is golden
- 34 upgrades you can see in the park
- 5 looks for the park: the classic park, Christmas, Halloween, Neon Night and black and white
- Police patrols and catchers with nets

Made by Lianes8 Studio.

#PidgeonPocket #IndieGame #SteamNextFest
